verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's pricing page documents a first-party ability to "import or sync your contacts and activity data," even on the free plan, so basic contact import exists. Nothing in the pack shows a guided migration flow from another email platform, or that tags, custom fields and unsubscribe/consent state carry over. The schemaless-data claims are API-level building blocks, not import behavior. Missing for 10: guided migration/import wizard, preservation of tags, custom-field mapping on import, carry-over of unsubscribe/suppression state, any hands-on corroboration.
